text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Work to start soon on a $53.5 million project at the Bahrain Petroleum Company to change its refinery's batch-blending process.
- Bahraini women are seeking election to the board of Bahrain's Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
- Health minister calls for building a joint transplant centre in Gulf Arab states to help treat more patients.
- Taib Securities and Equities Company intends to launch an investment portfolio.
- Health minister urges private investments in the health sector. Health Ministry's budget increased by 10 percent this year to around 45 million dinars, minister says.
